title: If AI Takes Junior Work, How Do Future CFOs Learn Judgment?
subtitle: CFO.com (Adam Zaki, published 25 September 2026) asks how finance talent will form if AI absorbs the tasks that used to train juniors. Meta CAO reports a seven-to-six-day close with AI flux analysis.
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 29 September 2026. Public facts from CFO.com 25 and 28 Sep 2026, KPMG Global AI in Finance 2026, Grant Thornton Q2 2026 CFO survey, AICPA/Clearinghouse via CFO Dive, Revelio Labs via Built In 21 Sep 2026. Composite firm: Godavari Industrials. Composite CFO: Meera Rao.
thumbnail: AI TOOK THE APPRENTICESHIP. WHO BUILDS JUDGMENT NOW?
